result:
All tests pass and typecheck is clean. Implementation complete:

- `src/server/services/member-service.ts`: added `suspendMember`, `reinstateMember`, `MemberSuspendedError`; `assertLastOwnerRetained` now only counts active (non-suspended) owners.
- `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts`: added `setMemberStatus` (suspend/reinstate without touching `archivedAt`); `countActiveMembers` now counts suspended members too (they keep their seat).
- `src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts`: seat rollup query updated the same way.
- `src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts`: `listOrgsForUser` excludes suspended members (org switcher).
- `src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts`: digest subscriber query now excludes suspended members.
- `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`: `notify()` skips suspended recipients.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`: mention resolution only considers active members.
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`: `createIssue`/`assignIssue` throw `MemberSuspendedError` when the assignee is suspended.
- `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`: added `member.suspended`/`member.reinstated` event and audit-action types.
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`: audit listeners for the two new events.
- `src/schemas/member.ts`: `suspendMemberSchema`/`reinstateMemberSchema`.
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`: labels for the new audit actions.
